facts.fact: 反叛有限度：她买了粉色运动裤——设计师款的。
facts.anchor: There were limits to how far I was prepared to rebel.

facts.fact: 冷资产登记：Astrid 是她终局棋盘上的另一枚棋子。
facts.anchor: Astrid Blackwood was another pawn I could use toward my endgame.

facts.fact: 峰会情报：季度女族长峰会完全离网——无手机、无数字网络、零男性武装卫兵。
facts.anchor: no phones, no digital networks, and zero armed male guards

facts.fact: Sorsha 今年首次获邀峰会（婚约到期）——两位女族长将同场。
facts.anchor: Mei Ling hadn't considered Sorsha a friend. So she hadn't been invited. Until this year, when my contract came due.

facts.fact: 她自己的议程第一条：母亲的死亡。
facts.anchor: The first item on the list was her demise.

facts.fact: Diego 报告：他刚走 Petrakis 就被 Blackwood 带走——Corin 会把知道的全招了。
facts.anchor: Just as I left, Petrakis was taken by the Blackwoods.

facts.fact: 她的自评：搅乱各领地的主谋，正躺在 Gunnar 的床上。
facts.anchor: the mastermind sowing chaos across the territories was lying right in his own bed

facts.fact: 她对 Diego 撒谎说没受伤——而她自己也分不清算不算谎。
facts.anchor: "No, he didn't hurt me," I lied.
